title: Per-PC Instruction Cache-Op Map
description: One manifest per (binary, kernel) pair. Produced by the L1 cache-op classifier from cuobjdump --dump-sass output. Carries a per-PC mapping from program counter to one of the 12 underscore-vocabulary instruction-cache-op tokens plus a derived L1-eligibility bool. The L1 predictor head consumes this manifest at predict time; absent manifest or parse failure fires typed_reason `predictor_l1_sass_provenance_missing` at the predictor.

schema_version.description: Map schema major version. Additive widenings (new enum values, new optional fields) do not bump; breaking changes do.

binary_source.description: Whether the SASS text came from a live `cuobjdump --dump-sass` invocation on an admitted-cell binary, or from a committed canned text fixture (used for Blackwell-only tokens on the sm_86-only development host).

arch_token.description: The compute capability tag of the cuobjdump output (e.g., `sm_86`, `sm_120`). Recorded for per-arch tolerance audits; the classifier does not gate on it.

kernel_mangled_name.description: The mangled kernel name whose SASS section the classifier walked. Absent when sass_provenance_status != matched.

binary_path.description: Repo-relative path of the binary the classifier introspected (live_cuobjdump case) or the canned-fixture identifier (canned_fixture case). Recorded for provenance.

sass_provenance_status.description: Outcome of the cuobjdump invocation + kernel-section extraction. `matched` admits a non-empty per_pc_instruction_cache_op array with at least one cache-accounted memory instruction; the other four values fire the L1 predictor head's typed_unavailable arm. `binary_not_parseable`, `no_kernel_section`, `kernel_section_empty` fire `predictor_l1_sass_provenance_missing` (the SASS provenance itself is unavailable). `matched_no_load_class_instructions` fires when the kernel section was parsed cleanly but contained no LDG / LDGSTS / LDL / STL / STG / ATOM / TEX class instructions (e.g., a shared-only kernel whose only loads are LDS / LDSM); the L1 head treats this as `predictor_l1_no_modeled_l1_eligible_accesses` because SASS is present and parseable, there is just nothing for the L1 model to walk.

pc.description: Program counter as a lowercase hex string with `0x` prefix.

instruction_cache_op.description: Closed set of 12 underscore-vocabulary tokens. Per the plan-pinned vocabulary, dotted SASS mnemonics (e.g., `LDG.E.CA`) are the parser input form only; the wire / schema / test fixtures all use the underscore form exclusively.

l1_eligible.description: Derived from instruction_cache_op. L1-eligible (touches L1): LDG_E_CA, LDG_E_EF, LDL, STL. L1-bypass (does NOT touch L1 modelable line state): LDG_E_CG, LDG_E_CS, LDG_E_STRONG_SM, LDG_E_STRONG_GPU, LDGSTS (async-copy without explicit staging), ATOM, TEX, OTHER. The token-to-l1_eligible partition is enforced at the schema boundary via the oneOf constraint below; the L1 predictor head additionally re-verifies eligibility at runtime via derive_l1_eligible(instruction_cache_op) and fails-closed with predictor_l1_sass_provenance_missing on any disagreement.

raw_mnemonic.description: Optional: the raw SASS opcode mnemonic the parser matched (e.g., `LDG.E.CA.U8`). Recorded for audit; not load-bearing for the predictor.

oneOf.description: L1-eligible token partition: LDG_E_CA / LDG_E_EF / LDL / STL MUST carry l1_eligible=true. Per BL-20260507-arch-token-multi-surface-lockstep, the partition mirrors the L1_ELIGIBLE_TOKENS frozenset in tools/cache_predictor/l1_cache_op_classifier.py; widening either surface requires updating the other in the same commit.

L1-bypass token partition: the other eight tokens MUST carry l1_eligible=false. LDG_E_CG / LDG_E_CS bypass L1 by virtue of the cache modifier; LDG_E_STRONG_SM / LDG_E_STRONG_GPU bypass on Blackwell via the strong-scope coherence path; LDGSTS bypasses L1 unless explicit staging is proven; ATOM goes to L2 or memory directly; TEX routes through the texture cache; OTHER is the conservative catch-all.

per_pc_instruction_cache_op.description: Per-PC mapping; empty array when sass_provenance_status != matched. The token-to-l1_eligible partition is enforced at the schema boundary so a contradictory entry (e.g., LDG_E_CG with l1_eligible=true) is rejected before the L1 predictor head ingests the manifest.

diagnostic.description: Free-text diagnostic when sass_provenance_status != matched. Captures the cuobjdump stderr tail or the parse failure shape so the operator can audit the typed_unavailable arm.

allOf.description: Status-mapping invariant: matched manifests carry at least one per-PC entry AND a kernel_mangled_name; non-matched manifests carry no per-PC entries AND a diagnostic field. The conditional arms enforce the fail-closed contract at the JSON Schema boundary so a downstream consumer cannot accept a contradictory provenance/status pairing.
binary_not_parseable arm: cuobjdump exited non-zero; per-PC map MUST be empty and diagnostic MUST be present.
no_kernel_section arm: the requested kernel marker was absent; per-PC map MUST be empty and diagnostic MUST be present.
kernel_section_empty arm: the kernel section had no SASS lines; per-PC map MUST be empty and diagnostic MUST be present.

matched_no_load_class_instructions arm: section parsed cleanly but contained no LDG / LDGSTS / LDL / STL / ATOM / TEX class instructions (e.g., a shared-only kernel). Per-PC map MUST be empty, kernel_mangled_name MUST be present (the section WAS found), and diagnostic MUST be present so the operator can audit.
